title: keel approval envelope
description: A Board approval: a detached, self-authenticating envelope committed at .keel/signatures/<blob-sha256>.<kind>.json (id AP-<sha12>). keel approve builds the payload, the Board signs its canonical JSON with ssh-keygen -Y sign -n keel-approval, and the Steward verifies it with ssh-keygen -Y verify against the allowed_signers blob at the last Board-signed trunk revision, never a working-tree copy. Any change to an approved artifact invalidates the approval. approve, dispatch and land exit 6 while any allowed signer key is agent-listed and is not a FIDO2 sk key.

subject.description: What is approved: a proposal or task id, a document path, a policy name, a question id or a record id.

commit.description:
Commit the artifacts were hashed at: keel/

/main for stages, trunk for documents.

artifacts.description: Every approved artifact with its normalized blob hash; empty for a request envelope.

request.description: The verbatim request, for request envelopes (keel new --policy).

quote.description: The quoted consent, with any Board commentary.

ledger_chain_head.description: hash of the last ledger event when signing, so later ledger edits are detectable; null only in the trust-on-first-use envelope keel init writes before the ledger exists.

nonce.description: 256 random bits written as 64 lowercase hex characters.

approvalKind.description: stage: contract, plan, land or receipt checkpoint; doc: a governance document (charter, goals, routing, allowed_signers); policy: a standing policy; request: a policy-path change request; rule: a ruling; tofu: the first signer recorded by keel init.

sha256.description: sha256 of the normalized blob at commit.

clause.description: Clause, finding or question the ruling settles.

budget.description: Set for a budget ruling (keel approve <subject> --rule budget --limit <usd|runs|wall_minutes>=<n>): the new limit for the approval subject (a goal, proposal or task); null otherwise.

track.description:
Set for a track ruling (keel approve

--rule track --to ): the recorded track and the track the Board sets; null otherwise.

landBinding.description: What a land approval binds. The landed commit is recorded later in the land.completed event.

receipt_draft.description: sha256 of the receipt draft the Board read.

familyPair.description: The declared engineer families (the build route and, when a test task runs, the test route) and the reviewer family: a declaration, never a verified fact.

engineer.description: Declared families of every engineer route the proposal uses; the reviewer family must differ from each.

independence.description: degraded needs keel approve --rule degraded for the change.

key_type.description: OpenSSH key type; FIDO2 sk key types are recommended on Windows.

armored.description: The armored SSH SIGNATURE block over the canonical JSON of payload.
